comment: Manual skip/override set for perl 5.20, built from the 2026-08-22 downstream re-evaluation (cleared-list run, classified per CLAUDE.md skip_codegen policy). Only entries that still fail after apidoc data 1.3-1.10 and the codegen fixes are registered.

patches.name: Perl_atof
patches.source_loc: perl-5.20/5.22 perl.h (#define Perl_atof(s) Perl_my_atof(s) under USE_PERL_ATOF)
patches.reason: The macro lacks aTHX_: Perl_my_atof takes (pTHX_ const char *s) on threaded builds, so the expansion is a 1-arg call to a 2-arg function (E0061). Latent in C because core code calls my_atof (embed.h adds aTHX_). Fixed upstream in 5.36. Same entry as in v5.32/v5.34.patches.json.

patches.name: S_perl_hash_djb2
patches.reason: Internal hash-function inline (hv_func.h) removed/reworked in modern perl. The old implementations use loop macros that reassign their induction variable (E0384 MURMUR_DOBYTES), u8/u32 mixed arithmetic (E0277) and assignment-position casts (E0067) that the codegen does not support. S_-prefixed internal implementation, not public API. Verified still failing in the 2026-08-22 re-evaluation.

patches.name: sv_collxfrm
patches.reason: Upstream sv.h bug on this version: `#define sv_collxfrm(sv, nxp) sv_cmp_flags(sv, nxp, SV_GMAGIC)` calls sv_cmp_flags instead of sv_collxfrm_flags, passing STRLEN* where SV* is expected (E0308). Latent in C because core code never calls the short name. Same entry as v5.26; fixed upstream by 5.34.

patches.name: PAD_RESTORE_LOCAL
patches.reason: 5.20's pad.h shape: the body passes opad (PAD * = AV *) to SvIS_FREED which takes SV *; the codegen does not insert the SV-family cast in this assert position (E0308 *const av vs *const sv). 5.22+ green. Candidate for a future codegen fix (family cast in call args).

patches.name: PAD_COMPNAME_FLAGS
patches.reason: 5.20's PAD_COMPNAME_* index the comppad_name AV directly ((*PAD_COMPNAME_SV(po)).sv_flags); the po index is inferred u64 where the generated PAD_COMPNAME_SV takes isize (E0308). 5.22+ green (padnamelist-based shape). Same residual index-type class.

patches.name: PAD_COMPNAME_PV
patches.reason: See PAD_COMPNAME_FLAGS (same 5.20-only index-type mismatch).

patches.name: RCPV_LEN
patches.reason: RCPV_* does not exist before perl 5.38 (cop.h RCPV refactor), so the common return_type_override has no target here and only emits a MISS warning (dict lookup fails; issue #17). Cancel the common patch on this version.
